compounding_lock.weekly: Each completed week's ending balance/equity becomes the starting capital base for the following week.
compounding_lock.month_boundary: The ending balance/equity of the final week crossing a month boundary carries directly into the first trading week of the following month; capital is never reset at month-end.

non_regression_rule: All future BUILD->TEST->REPAIR->RETEST->COMBINE->WEEKLY PORTFOLIO TEST cycles must compare against this baseline. Repairs are intended to improve opportunity capture, precision, drawdown, execution realism, asset participation and full-strategy evidence without knowingly degrading the established portfolio-return behaviour. Any diagnostic run that falls below baseline is not a promoted replacement and cannot overwrite this baseline unless the user explicitly authorizes a new baseline.
truth_constraint: This baseline is a research-performance comparator, not a live-capital or broker-certified performance claim. Broker/execution certification must be added without silently weakening the baseline comparator.
